request.spec:
Backing is now the sum of the patrons' settled figures over their SETTLED claims dated within the
90 days up to and including the sheet's today (each at its frozen figure), 0.00 with none.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Backing is now the sum of the patrons' settled figures over their SETTLED claims dated within the
90 days up to and including the sheet's today (each at its frozen figure), 0.00 with none.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Backing now counts only the patrons' recent settled claims, and all 4 tests in the acceptance spec pass when run with `bin/e2e`.

A person's backing is now the sum of the frozen figures of their patrons' SETTLED claims dated within the 90 days up to and including the sheet's today. In date terms, that's from today minus 89 days through today. With no such claims, it shows 0.00. Before, backing was the sum of the patrons' due-totals.

The only change is the `backingBy` computation in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`. Backing is calculated only on screen: the server doesn't compute it and the audit file doesn't record it, so no server, storage or audit changes were needed. Draft, open, pending and voided claims no longer count toward backing. Rate changes don't affect it either, because each settled claim keeps the figure it was settled at.
